decisions.quote: In short, none of the three replication studies was able to detect the precognitive effect (53.1%) reported by Bem [ 35 ]—neither with exploratory (PCH-based) nor confirmatory analyses.
decisions.reason: The shipped quote omitted an intervening sentence and misread Study 2's confirmation of an exploratory below-chance effect (in the opposite direction of Bem's claim, which then failed to replicate in Study 3) as support for the original finding. The authors explicitly conclude that none of their three studies detected Bem's claimed above-chance precognitive effect and that the original claim was disconfirmed.
